verdict.rationale: LegalOS is an attorney-led immigration filing service: guided intake, evidence organization, and attorney-reviewed petitions. It is not a platform where users author automations, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user automations is a category error for this kind of product. Its mention of 'AI workflows' describes its internal case-preparation process, not user-built automations, and nothing in the pack shows user-configurable automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
